cohort: The study cohort consisted of adults who underwent major non-cardiac surgery at Tygerberg Hospital in Cape Town, South Africa.
finding: The overall incidence of AKI after major non-cardiac surgery was 11.2%, with independent risk factors including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, specific surgical disciplines (trauma, abdominal, vascular, urology), red blood cell transfusion, emergency surgery, and inotrope use.
